Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Ananya - 11 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Hema - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Manoj - 39 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Ananya, Hema and Manoj stand near him.]

Ishaan: "What lovely weather!"

[Ishaan puts on his school uniform.]

Manoj: "Really?"

[Ishaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Ishaan: "Really?"

[Ishaan puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Manoj: "What next?"

[Ananya puts on red lipstick.]

Ananya: "Dad, are you okay?"

[Ananya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Hema (laughing): "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The fishermen's village - Day

[Ishaan stands in the village. Hema and Manoj stand near him.]

Ishaan: "So, here we are!"

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Manoj (laughing): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
